title: Russian Mi-8 Helicopter Briefly Crosses Into Polish Airspace Near Braniewo
detail: A Russian Mi-8 military helicopter flying out of Kaliningrad Oblast crossed into Polish airspace north of Braniewo at approximately 11:08 on September 23, penetrating roughly 300 metres before exiting after 42 seconds. Polish radar tracked the helicopter throughout; fighter jets were scrambled and ground-based forces and air-defence assets were placed on standby. Poland's Operational Command said "the nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defence," while acknowledging it had not publicly presented evidence establishing whether the crossing was deliberate or the result of navigational error. Officials and outlets described it as the first publicly reported instance of a Russian military helicopter crossing Poland's land border, following a string of Russian aircraft and drone violations over Polish Baltic waters in 2025-2026. The Russian embassy in Warsaw had not responded to requests for comment at the time of reporting.
